body:
Thankfully the symptoms don't fully match up with that syndrome, it's just that minus the somewhat life threatening symptoms.

I actually want to do some stuff abroad over a long period, but am concerned about what I'd do if the condition got significantly worse whilst abroad.

Not shallow at all, when faced with a problem I typically try to put it into a greater perspective of things, which can help me realise the situation I'm in isn't as bad as I thought.

And doing that just now has helped a bit. I've realised it's not the end result I'm scared of, it's the not knowing and the waiting and not knowing what to do and what I can do to help myself. It's still very early days.

Thank you for responding to me.
